svg.title: Another organization proposes a correction for the owner to review
svg.desc: On one instance, an analyst in Org B submits an attribute proposal to an event created by Org A. Saving the proposal does not modify the original attribute. An authorized publisher in Org A inspects the proposal and either accepts it, applying the change and unpublishing the event, or discards it, leaving the source content unchanged. Accepted changes require review and explicit republication. Cross-instance proposal delivery depends on synchronization settings.
